moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description:
Fire (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Burns the target.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description:
Dark (Special)
Base Power: 55
Accuracy: 95
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description:
Dark (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description:
Ghost (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Roseli Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fairy-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Lum Berry
items.description: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
